brief:
Israeli forces killed at least seven Palestinians, including a child, in separate strikes across Gaza on Thursday, according to the civil defence rescue service. The deaths occurred throughout the day in multiple locations across the territory.

Middle East Eye reported the toll came from distinct Israeli military operations rather than a single incident. Further details on the locations and circumstances of the strikes were not immediately available.
dek: Israeli forces kill at least seven Palestinians in separate attacks across Gaza At least seven Palestinians, including a child, were killed in separate Israeli strikes throughout the day, Gaza’s civil defence rescue service said on Thursday.
title: Israeli forces kill at least seven Palestinians in Gaza attacks
